           <h1>Meshery v0.4.15</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.4.15">Released</a> on October 23, 2020</h4>

<h3 id="whats-new">What’s new?</h3>

<ul>
  <li>
    <p>General</p>

    <ul>
      <li>Trying to get the signoff check this time @alonsolopezr (#1724)</li>
      <li>Added SMP Logo in ReadMe @Aarush-Goyal (#1648)</li>
      <li>[mesheryctl]Attempt to start docker daemon during mesheryctl installation @hexxdump (#1685)</li>
      <li>Changed lifecycle method for props update @dhruv0000 (#1722)</li>
      <li>fix(UI): Persist Grafana charts after a Reloading @dhruv0000 (#1721)</li>
      <li>[Adapter] Remove NGINX SM Adapter from Stable release channel pending adapter beta release @leecalcote (#1714)</li>
      <li>Add experimental subcommand to mesheryctl @anirudhjain75 (#1715)</li>
      <li>nginx adapter changes without the svgs @kumarabd (#1705)</li>
      <li>[mesheryctl] #1708 version command add indicator to user @cardinalion (#1710)</li>
      <li>[mesheryctl] Fix command provides invalid upgrade prompt #1707 @cardinalion (#1709)</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>
    <p>Features</p>

    <ul>
      <li>[Docs] feature update @chandrashritii (#1719)</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>
    <p>Documentation</p>

    <ul>
      <li>[Docs] feature update @chandrashritii (#1719)</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<h3 id="whats-new">What’s new?</h3>

<ul>
  <li>
    <p>General</p>

      <li>Minor correction of words in the kinD quick start page @alonsolopezr (#1759)</li>
      <li>fix: remove the duplicate function required for version checking @kushthedude (#1767)</li>
      <li>Getting the gke quick start page, translation to es in the docs-pages… @alonsolopezr (#1757)</li>
      <li>[Docs] Translate Project page to Spanish @homero304 (#1740)</li>
      <li>[mesheryctl] Add prerequisite on docker daemon running status @hexxdump (#1746)</li>
      <li>Add latest available version in the API and in the dashboard @utkarsh-pro (#1761)</li>
      <li>enh: populate loadGenerator in SMP results @kushthedude (#1765)</li>
      <li>[ImgBot] Optimize images @IMGBOT (#1764)</li>
      <li>[Docs] Section update @chandrashritii (#1726)</li>
      <li>[Docs] fixes #1748 SVG of Meshery Architecture Diagram @DanRowe1 (#1760)</li>
      <li>Updated WSL link Signed-off-by: Bart Kalanski bkalanski@gmail.com @bartkalanski (#1755)</li>
      <li>Getting the docker quick start page, translation to es in the docs-pa… @alonsolopezr (#1744)</li>
      <li>Getting the aks quick start page, translation to es in the docs/pages… @alonsolopezr (#1741)</li>
      <li>Getting the eks quick start page, translation to es in the docs-pages… @alonsolopezr (#1743)</li>
      <li>[UI] update nginx-sm logo @leecalcote (#1750)</li>
      <li>fixes for remote provider @kumarabd (#1739)</li>
      <li>[Docs] README - Add NGINX Service Mesh adapter @UnkleTayo (#1736)</li>
      <li>reorder menu items in alphabetical order - i1735 @amanda-ariyaratne (#1737)</li>
      <li>generate default mesheryctl config if one doesn’t exist or invalid on… @anirudhjain75 (#1693)</li>
      <li>[Fix - #1728] - Replacing the Traefik logo to minimal-version @akashprasher (#1733)</li>
      <li>chore: upgrade nighthawk-go package version @kushthedude (#1732)</li>
    </ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.4.17</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.4.17">Released</a> on October 29, 2020</h4>

<h3 id="whats-new">What’s new?</h3>

<ul>
  <li>
    <p>General</p>

    <ul>
      <li>Translation of the kubernetes quick start pageto es, just added this … @alonsolopezr (#1774)</li>
      <li>Getting the kinD quick start page, translation to es in the docs-page… @alonsolopezr (#1758)</li>
      <li>[Docs] update resources page @chandrashritii (#1771)</li>
      <li>Bump the chart version and add mesheryconsul adapter @Aisuko (#1781)</li>
      <li>[provider-ui] - Add Integration test for Provider UI @ramrodo (#1778)</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>
    <p>Bug Fixes</p>

    <ul>
      <li>Generate meshery config dir at mesheryctl init @nitishm (#1780)</li>
      <li>fix: ubuntu sh is linked to dash @kushthedude (#1777)</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>
    <p>Documentation</p>

    <ul>
      <li>[Docs] Architecture diagrams @leecalcote (#1783)</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.4.19</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.4.19">Released</a> on November 10, 2020</h4>

<h3 id="whats-new">What’s new?</h3>

<ul>
  <li>
    <p>General</p>

    <ul>
      <li>Add meshery-kuma @Aisuko (#1854)</li>
      <li>Add the meshery-osm chart @Aisuko (#1802)</li>
      <li>Add support for linkerd in the dashboard service mesh view @utkarsh-pro (#1881)</li>
      <li>Add permission to watch the nodes @Aisuko (#1893)</li>
      <li>add shell completion command @WLun001 (#1877)</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>
    <p>Bug Fixes</p>

    <ul>
      <li>fix: bash script to utilise dynamic input @kushthedude (#1875)</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>
    <p>Maintenance</p>

    <ul>
      <li>[UI] Add e2e test for /userpreference @ramrodo (#1862)</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>
    <p>Documentation</p>

    <ul>
      <li>Docs: add AKS installation instructions for Meshery @kushthedude (#1871)</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.4.2</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.4.2">Released</a> on August 17, 2020</h4>

<h3 id="whats-new">What’s new?</h3>

<ul>
  <li>
    <p>Features</p>

    <ul>
      <li>Update CRUD operations on test config</li>
      <li>Fix for unwanted snackbar in perf preferences tab</li>
      <li>Add validation for protocol in URL</li>
      <li>Initialize OSM adapter for Meshery</li>
      <li>Add new command restart to mesheryctl</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>
    <p>Maintenance</p>

    <ul>
      <li>Fix broken ci for ui tests</li>
      <li>Optimize images</li>
      <li>Remove redundant step from docker push</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>
    <p>Documentation</p>

    <ul>
      <li>Remove broken links from table of supported platforms</li>
      <li>Remove example of brew upgrade mesheryctl output</li>
      <li>Create smi-conformance-capability.md file</li>
      <li>Fix documentation site broken links</li>
      <li>Fix broken link to SMP in release.md</li>
      <li>Upgrade Meshery Kuma Adapter to beta</li>
      <li>Update adapter docs</li>
      <li>Add logos to assets folder</li>
      <li>Add Open Service Mesh to list</li>
      <li>Fix typo error in App Mesh Adapter description</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>
    <p>Bug Fixes</p>
    <ul>
      <li>Create/Delete/Read on user test profiles</li>
      <li>Fix for the results page</li>
      <li>Fix releaseDrafter configuration file</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ul>

 

   <br/>


        </div>
      </main>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.4.20</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.4.20">Released</a> on November 12, 2020</h4>

<h3 id="whats-new">What’s new?</h3>

<ul>
  <li>
    <p>General</p>

    <ul>
      <li>Overview page spanish translation @Drake8710 (#1742)</li>
      <li>Ccoss2020 fixes1803 @Drake8710 (#1804)</li>
      <li>Add partial translation of functionality section @jlcastrogro (#1793)</li>
      <li>Add meshery adaptor chart for networking service mesh @Aisuko (#1900)</li>
      <li>Add service mesh control plane dashboard for Consul, OSM, NSM, Citrix @utkarsh-pro (#1902)</li>
      <li>Revert “add new mesheryctl command” @kumarabd (#1910)</li>
      <li>add new mesheryctl command @chandrashritii (#1908)</li>
      <li>Updated ‘Signed Commits’ URL in PR_Template #1905 @Aniruddha-Shriwant (#1906)</li>
      <li>[Docs] Add lightbox plugin @chandrashritii (#1903)</li>
      <li>[provider-ui] Add e2e test to provider-ui to test modal @ramrodo (#1901)</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>
    <p>Maintenance</p>

    <ul>
      <li>Bump @fortawesome/fontawesome-svg-core from 1.2.30 to 1.2.32 in /ui @dependabot-preview (#1888)</li>
      <li>Bump notistack from 0.8.9 to 1.0.1 in /ui @dependabot-preview (#1850)</li>
      <li>Bump react-dom from 16.13.1 to 16.14.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot-preview (#1884)</li>
      <li>Bump mui-datatables from 3.6.0 to 3.7.1 in /ui @dependabot-preview (#1883)</li>
      <li>Bump @fortawesome/free-regular-svg-icons from 5.14.0 to 5.15.1 in /ui @dependabot-preview (#1885)</li>
      <li>Bump billboard.js from 1.11.0 to 2.1.3 in /ui @dependabot-preview (#1887)</li>
      <li>Bump @babel/traverse from 7.9.6 to 7.12.5 in /ui @dependabot-preview (#1892)</li>
      <li>Bump caniuse-lite from 1.0.30001109 to 1.0.30001157 in /ui @dependabot-preview (#1891)</li>
      <li>Bump @fortawesome/free-brands-svg-icons from 5.14.0 to 5.15.1 in /ui @dependabot-preview (#1889)</li>
      <li>Bump react-jss from 10.3.0 to 10.4.0 in /ui @dependabot-preview (#1890)</li>
      <li>Bump eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y from 6.3.1 to 6.4.1 in /ui @dependabot-preview (#1886)</li>
      <li>Bump eslint from 7.12.1 to 7.13.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot-preview (#1882)</li>
      <li>chore: meshery workflow fires up on release @kushthedude (#1898)</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.4.21">Released</a> on November 12, 2020</h4>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.4.23</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.4.23">Released</a> on November 19, 2020</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>

<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Add redirectErrorToConsole method to let mesh sync call fail silently @utkarsh-pro (#1949)</li>
  <li>Utkarsh pro/meshery/kubernetes service scan @utkarsh-pro (#1928)</li>
  <li>fix: golangci-lint failures @kushthedude (#1945)</li>
  <li>All releases between v0.4.22 and v0.4.4 added @ezioishan (#1943)</li>
  <li>[UI] External Link Icon @Sudhish2101 (#1913)</li>
  <li>Update mui-datatables to 3.7.1 @ramrodo (#1925)</li>
  <li>Rename name column to “control plane pods” and add tooltip with fullname @utkarsh-pro (#1924)</li>
  <li>Proposal for replacing kubescan with new implementation @utkarsh-pro (#1923)</li>
  <li>Fix eslint error for “TemplateLiteral” and fix package-lock.json for billboard.js @ramrodo (#1921)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump eslint from 7.6.0 to 7.13.0 in /ui @dependabot-preview (#1935)</li>
  <li>Bump react-jss from 10.4.0 to 10.5.0 in /ui @dependabot-preview (#1941)</li>
  <li>Bump jss from 10.4.0 to 10.5.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot-preview (#1930)</li>
  <li>Bump cypress from 5.5.0 to 5.6.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot-preview (#1931)</li>
</ul>

 

   <br/>

      </main>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.4.25</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.4.25">Released</a> on November 29, 2020</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>

<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[ doc ] add completion doc @jiraguha (#1962)</li>
  <li>fixes #1954 @vineethvanga18 (#1958)</li>
  <li>Replace the chart icon @Aisuko (#1955)</li>
  <li>Reformat the rest of the adapter charts @Aisuko (#1917)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-bug-fixes">🐛 Bug Fixes</h2>

<ul>
  <li>fix: backend build for meshery @kushthedude (#1979)</li>
  <li>fix: docker builds failures in CI @kushthedude (#1959)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>fix: backend build for meshery @kushthedude (#1979)</li>
  <li>Bump start-server-and-test from 1.11.2 to 1.11.5 in /ui @dependabot-preview (#1939)</li>
  <li>Bump cypress from 5.5.0 to 5.6.0 in /ui @dependabot-preview (#1940)</li>
  <li>fix: docker builds failures in CI @kushthedude (#1959)</li>
  <li>Bump uuid from 8.3.0 to 8.3.1 in /ui @dependabot-preview (#1932)</li>
  <li>Bump husky from 4.2.5 to 4.3.0 in /ui @dependabot-preview (#1938)</li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.4.26</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.4.26">Released</a> on December 10, 2020</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>

<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>fixes for grafana bug @kumarabd (#2073)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Implement meshery update prompt mesheryctl @uds5501 (#2052)</li>
  <li>Bump the meshery chart’s version @Aisuko (#2071)</li>
  <li>Change the selector value to configuration @Aisuko (#2066)</li>
  <li>Updated CONTRIBUTING.md to reflect update to Go 1.15 @mgfeller (#2068)</li>
  <li>Restructure adapter dashboard @utkarsh-pro (#2069)</li>
  <li>[UI] Resize sidebar to accommodate external links @uds5501 (#2037)</li>
  <li>Kalradev/meshsync/endpoint @kalradev (#2013)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-bug-fixes">🐛 Bug Fixes</h2>

<ul>
  <li>fix: restructure mesheryctl version error handling @kushthedude (#1791)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump @material-ui/lab from 4.0.0-alpha.56 to 4.0.0-alpha.57 in /ui @dependabot-preview (#2059)</li>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.4.3</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.4.3">Released</a> on August 22, 2020</h4>

<h3 id="whats-new">What’s new?</h3>

<ul>
  <li>
    <p>Features</p>

    <ul>
      <li>Use Open Service Mesh in place of osm</li>
      <li>Duration field use dropdown + text in performance preference</li>
      <li>Added tooltips for navigation menu items while in minimised state</li>
      <li>Added community calendar button</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>
    <p>Documentation</p>

    <ul>
      <li>Doc pages fixed</li>
      <li>Updated README.md</li>
      <li>Added first timers’ and welcome guide link</li>
      <li>Added “Open Service Mesh” to navigation menu in Meshery docs</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>
    <p>Bug fixes</p>
    <ul>
      <li>smi-conformance - added Colons to front matter</li>
      <li>Missing bottom row added</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ul>

 

   <br/>


        </div>
      </main>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.4.4</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.4.4">Released</a> on August 27, 2020</h4>

<h3 id="whats-new">What’s new?</h3>

<ul>
  <li>
    <p>Features</p>

    <ul>
      <li>Added timeout in golang-ci lint</li>
      <li>Moved to Gorilla/mux for server routing</li>
      <li>Migrated to golangci-lint</li>
      <li>Initialised nighthawk load generator interface</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>
    <p>Maintenance</p>

    <ul>
      <li>Updated meshmap branch to latest on master branch</li>
      <li>Made page heading title bold</li>
      <li>Moved meshery adapter for osm</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>
    <p>Documentation</p>

    <ul>
      <li>Added extra RVM notes for Windows Users</li>
      <li>Added SMI screenshot and description</li>
      <li>Added the current version of osm</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>
    <p>Bug fixes</p>
    <ul>
      <li>Auto detecting kube configuration</li>
      <li>Fixed the footer social bar</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ul>

 

   <br/>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.4.5</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.4.5">Released</a> on September 02, 2020</h4>

<h3 id="whats-new">What’s new?</h3>

<ul>
  <li>
    <p>General</p>

    <ul>
      <li>[ImgBot] Optimize images @IMGBOT (#1514)</li>
      <li>added kuma service mesh @kumarabd (#1473)</li>
      <li>ADDED SAMPLE APPLICATION @was-coder (#1511)</li>
      <li>Updated citrix adapter to reflect supported operations” @KarenEfereyan (#1513)</li>
      <li>Sample application edited @was-coder (#1503)</li>
      <li>Udoka vrede branch @UdokaVrede (#1500)</li>
      <li>Added SMI conformance capability as a feature to KUMA adapter” @KarenEfereyan (#1492)</li>
      <li>Update README.mb @NorbertLuszkiewicz (#1480)
#1476 @7daytheory (#1478)</li>
      <li>fix wsl 404s @thegagne (#1497)</li>
      <li>Added the Correct Slack link in contributing.md @akashgp09 (#1484)</li>
      <li>removed ‘common issues’ heading and fixed typo @tim-hanke (#1477)</li>
      <li>Merge master into meshmap @kushthedude (#1472)</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>
    <p>Maintenance</p>

    <ul>
      <li>Bump github.com/gorilla/mux from 1.7.4 to 1.8.0 @dependabot-preview (#1508)</li>
      <li>Bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.31.0 to 1.31.1 @dependabot-preview (#1507)</li>
      <li>Bump fortio.org/fortio from 1.6.4 to 1.6.8 @dependabot-preview (#1509)</li>
      <li>Bump github.com/prometheus/common from 0.10.0 to 0.13.0 @dependabot-preview (#1506)</li>
      <li>CI: improvise actions executed &amp; remove tool configs @kushthedude (#1494)</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.4.7</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.4.7">Released</a> on September 25, 2020</h4>

<h3 id="whats-new">What’s new?</h3>

<ul>
  <li>
    <p>General</p>

    <ul>
      <li>Fix some frond-end console waring @PmcFizz (#1596)</li>
      <li>Improve URL matching regex pattern. @shubhamgupta2956 (#1583)</li>
      <li>fixed the iframe @jomefavourite (#1550)</li>
      <li>Update osm port @ratatatCat (#1565)</li>
      <li>enh: add autolabeller action @kushthedude (#1573)</li>
      <li>[docs]Update Meshery Contributing Doc @Harshita-Kanal (#1567)</li>
      <li>fix: labeler config file @kushthedude (#1560)</li>
      <li>[CI] Update PR labeler config @leecalcote (#1559)</li>
      <li>[CI] PR Labeler test with docs update @leecalcote (#1558)</li>
      <li>[meshery]: chore / smps to smp @kalradev (#1555)</li>
      <li>[Docs] fixed broken hyperlink in README @Gregxd11 (#1546)</li>
      <li>Updated reserved network port from 10009 to 10010 @guacamole (#1545)</li>
      <li>Added supported operations for CPX adapter under heading “Sample Appl… @KarenEfereyan (#1535)</li>
      <li>“Add Load Generators Description ” @Annysah (#1533)</li>
      <li>include supported operations @lolyparty (#1534)</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>
    <p>Features</p>

    <ul>
      <li>feat: package nighthawk with meshery @kushthedude (#1601)</li>
      <li>feat: complete nighthawk integration with meshery @kushthedude (#1505)</li>
      <li>Add Consul Service mesh adaptor options to helm chart @nicholasjackson (#1568)</li>
      <li>CI: establish edge release channel @kushthedude (#1570)</li>
      <li>feat: add deployment yamls for meshery-kuma adapter @kushthedude (#1539)</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>
    <p>Bug Fixes</p>

    <ul>
      <li>fix: welcome bot configuration @kushthedude (#1592)</li>
      <li>fix: docker build arguement missing @kushthedude (#1575)</li>
      <li>Fix: build and release pipelines of Meshery @kushthedude (#1572)</li>
      <li>fix: k8s deployment for osm @kushthedude (#1525)</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>
    <p>Maintenance</p>

    <ul>
      <li>fix: welcome bot configuration @kushthedude (#1592)</li>
      <li>CI: establish edge release channel @kushthedude (#1570)</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>
    <p>Documentation</p>

    <ul>
      <li>Kumarabd/feature/smi test persistence @kumarabd (#1578)</li>
      <li>added release notes v0.4.3 @anshdhinhgra47 (#1600)</li>
      <li>READ-ME Updated with 4.1 release notes @accordingtoherr (#1595)</li>
      <li>added missing windows installation steps @abiodunolunu (#1587)</li>
      <li>docs: remove the deprecated make action @kushthedude (#1586)</li>
      <li>Add SMI Conformance capability to Istio Adapter @KarenEfereyan (#1582)</li>
      <li>Added network port for Learn Meshery in docs @KarenEfereyan (#1581)</li>
      <li>Changed OSM network port from 10010 to 10009 @KarenEfereyan (#1580)</li>
      <li>Replace hardcoded docs url with a constant. @Sylfrena (#1496)</li>
      <li>Removed reverse order from Meshery functionality page @KarenEfereyan (#1563)</li>
      <li>[Docs] general documentation fixes for adapters @chandrashritii (#1536)</li>
      <li>Docs: Added the supported operation for the meshery adapter for Tanzu @Kennygrace (#1532)</li>
      <li>updated Consul version to 1.8 and removed sentence SMI adapter for ku… @Rex739 (#1526)</li>
      <li>docs: Improve the readability of the table in readme.md @NorbertLuszkiewicz (#1531)</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.4.8</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.4.8">Released</a> on September 28, 2020</h4>

<h3 id="whats-new">What’s new?</h3>

<ul>
  <li>
    <p>General</p>

    <ul>
      <li>Fixed broken image Signed-off-by: Bart Kalanski bkalanski@gmail.com @bartkalanski (#1609)</li>
    </ul>
  </li>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>
