<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.5.0-beta-1</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.0-beta-1">Released</a> on January 26, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>

<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>persistence changes for meshsync data @kumarabd (#2293)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Feature: <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">system reset --context/-c</code> to temporarily change context @navendu-pottekkat (#2288)</li>
  <li>Revert “Fix Netlify configuration to only build on “docs” changes” @ramrodo (#2291)</li>
  <li>Fix Netlify configuration to only build on “docs” changes @ramrodo (#2289)</li>
  <li>[Chart] Bump the charts version @Aisuko (#2286)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Feature: <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">system reset</code> should ask confirmation from the user @navendu-pottekkat (#2287)</li>
  <li>Promote Traefik Mesh @SantoDE (#2263)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Make ‘system reset’ context aware @navendu-pottekkat (#2265)</li>
  <li>add configuration env.SAAS_BASE_URL to values.yaml @zjyingchang (#2282)</li>
  <li>Kumarabd/feature/graphql @kumarabd (#2276)</li>
  <li>change image name nginx @navendu-pottekkat (#2275)</li>
  <li>[Docs] mesheryctl command reference collection @chandrashritii (#2264)</li>
  <li>changes for MESHSYNC persistence @kumarabd (#2150)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Dynamically modified docker-compose based on current-context @anirudhjain75 (#2236)</li>
  <li>Add stats collection @utkarsh-pro (#2244)</li>
  <li>Adding Operator Settings in Environments Tab @dhruv0000 (#2243)</li>
  <li>Runtime Error Fix @vinayaksh42 (#2240)</li>
  <li>Fix performance test result download @utkarsh-pro (#2238)</li>
  <li>Restyle notifications and notification drawer @utkarsh-pro (#2237)</li>
  <li>mesheryctl: Added current-context for system channel command @SudhanAruna (#2209)</li>
  <li>remotecomponent for userpref @vineethvanga18 (#2227)</li>
  <li>[UI] Add Favicon for both provider ui and ui @weastel (#2233)</li>
  <li>Replace route2 to intercept command in Cypress tests @ramrodo (#2216)</li>
  <li>Added Relay Environment @dhruv0000 (#2205)</li>
  <li>Realign pic in Functionality section of main README @alphaX86 (#2229)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Add support for EKS config @hexxdump (#1995)</li>
  <li>Remove cfg.go and its remnants from a faulty merge @anirudhjain75 (#2230)</li>
  <li>[CI] Goreleaser support for release channel @leecalcote (#2221)</li>
  <li>Replace hardcoded URL with Endpoints from context @anirudhjain75 (#2199)</li>
  <li>fix: mesheryctl build config uses deprecated options @kushthedude (#2206)</li>
  <li>Add a GOPROXY @ramrodo (#2198)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Pre-run check before checking system version @uds5501 (#2109)</li>
  <li>Add SAAS_BASE_URL to docker-compose again to support stable release @utkarsh-pro (#2193)</li>
  <li>Add parameters on the chart’s readme @Aisuko (#2146)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Split config functionality and refractor @anirudhjain75 (#2163)</li>
  <li>Promote Meshery Adapter for Traefik Mesh to beta @utkarsh-pro (#2189)</li>
  <li>None provider version synced with meshery versions @utkarsh-pro (#2156)</li>
  <li>updated traefik mesh status @kevtainer (#2143)</li>
  <li>[WIP] UI Extension points @utkarsh-pro (#2145)</li>
  <li>[API] Restructure user preferences endpoint @leecalcote (#2142)</li>
  <li>[Meshery] NATS subscriber implementation @kalradev (#2144)</li>
  <li>Broken SMP reference; broken prompt-ui references @leecalcote (#2135)</li>
  <li>Added SMP versioning @dhruv0000 (#2129)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Revert interactive prompt to classic y/n @uds5501 (#2108)</li>
  <li>Fetch version from ldflags @anirudhjain75 (#2124)</li>
  <li>Correct channel command execution message @JubayerJoy (#2103)</li>
  <li>Add Grafana Charts to the Service Mesh Management Page @utkarsh-pro (#2081)</li>
  <li>fix: nighthawk-go library version @kushthedude (#2097)</li>
  <li>Remove default location from usage test and let cobra handle that @anirudhjain75 (#2032)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-features">🚀 Features</h2>

<ul>
  <li>feat: invoke nighthawk in meshery @kushthedude (#2096)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[CI] Implement Code Coverage for Cypress tests @ramrodo (#2258)</li>
  <li>[CI] Add e2e tests to Settings &gt; Service Meshes / consul @ramrodo (#2218)</li>
  <li>Bump next from 10.0.3 to 10.0.5 in /provider-ui @dependabot-preview (#2223)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/Mesheryio/nighthawk-go from 0.1.4 to 0.1.5 @dependabot-preview (#2172)</li>
  <li>Add release_channel to the version api response and remove radio buttons from the UI @utkarsh-pro (#2200)</li>
  <li>Bump codemirror from 5.59.0 to 5.59.1 in /ui @dependabot-preview (#2178)</li>
  <li>Bump eslint-plugin-react from 7.21.5 to 7.22.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot-preview (#2185)</li>
  <li>Bump cypress from 6.1.0 to 6.2.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot-preview (#2181)</li>
  <li>Bump start-server-and-test from 1.11.6 to 1.11.7 in /ui @dependabot-preview (#2182)</li>
  <li>Bump @babel/types from 7.12.11 to 7.12.12 in /ui @dependabot-preview (#2180)</li>
  <li>Bump start-server-and-test from 1.11.6 to 1.11.7 in /provider-ui @dependabot-preview (#2183)</li>
  <li>Bump eslint-plugin-react from 7.21.5 to 7.22.0 in /ui @dependabot-preview (#2177)</li>
  <li>Bump caniuse-lite from 1.0.30001170 to 1.0.30001171 in /ui @dependabot-preview (#2176)</li>
  <li>Bump @babel/traverse from 7.12.10 to 7.12.12 in /ui @dependabot-preview (#2188)</li>
  <li>Bump notistack from 1.0.2 to 1.0.3 in /ui @dependabot-preview (#2179)</li>
  <li>Bump gopkg.in/yaml.v2 from 2.3.0 to 2.4.0 @dependabot-preview (#2171)</li>
  <li>Bump fortio.org/fortio from 1.11.0 to 1.11.4 @dependabot-preview (#2175)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/gofrs/uuid from 3.3.0+incompatible to 3.4.0+incompatible @dependabot-preview (#2167)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/prometheus/client_golang from 1.8.0 to 1.9.0 @dependabot-preview (#2174)</li>
  <li>Bump cypress from 6.1.0 to 6.2.0 in /ui @dependabot-preview (#2184)</li>
  <li>Bump @fortawesome/react-fontawesome from 0.1.13 to 0.1.14 in /ui @dependabot-preview (#2187)</li>
  <li>[CI] Add e2e test for /settings &gt; Environment @ramrodo (#2139)</li>
  <li>fix: ci issues in ui @kushthedude (#2192)</li>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.5.0-beta-2</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.0-beta-2">Released</a> on February 08, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>

<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Kumarabd/feature/graphql @kumarabd (#2379)</li>
  <li>Kumarabd/feature/graphql @kumarabd (#2344)</li>
  <li>Moved NGINX SM to beta section @bartkalanski (#2377)</li>
  <li>Fix #2367 @tripathyprateek (#2369)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] fix Bug: <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">system reset</code> on <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">stable</code> channel breaks if no version is specified @aneeshnema (#2368)</li>
  <li>Use v2 of goreleaser Github Action and remove the condition @ramrodo (#2364)</li>
  <li>Fix bootup bug @anirudhjain75 (#2347)</li>
  <li>fix for operator chipy @kumarabd (#2345)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] perculate the silentFlag to PreReqChecks as well. @hexxdump (#2313)</li>
  <li>Fix Netlify builds @ramrodo (#2292)</li>
  <li>[Docs] Add doc for –verbose flag @navendu-pottekkat (#2306)</li>
  <li>remove spacing and update labels @killbotXD (#2305)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Feature: <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">--verbose</code> <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">-v</code> global flags for verbose logs @navendu-pottekkat (#2299)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Add silent flag to system start command @hexxdump (#2298)</li>
  <li>Updated SMP module version @dhruv0000 (#2297)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump nodemon from 2.0.6 to 2.0.7 in /ui @dependabot (#2356)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/service-mesh-performance/service-mesh-performance from 0.3.2 to 0.3.3 @dependabot (#2359)</li>
  <li>Bump @babel/types from 7.12.12 to 7.12.13 in /ui @dependabot (#2361)</li>
  <li>Bump react-codemirror2 from 5.1.0 to 7.2.1 in /ui @dependabot (#2352)</li>
  <li>Bump eslint from 7.16.0 to 7.19.0 in /ui @dependabot-preview (#2329)</li>
  <li>Bump caniuse-lite from 1.0.30001181 to 1.0.30001183 in /ui @dependabot (#2357)</li>
  <li>Bump @date-io/moment from 2.10.6 to 2.10.8 in /ui @dependabot (#2353)</li>
  <li>Bump @fortawesome/free-brands-svg-icons from 5.15.1 to 5.15.2 in /ui @dependabot (#2355)</li>
  <li>Bump start-server-and-test from 1.11.7 to 1.12.0 in /ui @dependabot (#2360)</li>
  <li>Bump codemirror from 5.59.1 to 5.59.2 in /ui @dependabot (#2362)</li>
  <li>Bump @fortawesome/fontawesome-svg-core from 1.2.32 to 1.2.34 in /ui @dependabot (#2354)</li>
  <li>Bump @paciolan/remote-component from 2.10.3 to 2.11.0 in /ui @dependabot (#2363)</li>
  <li>Bump cypress from 6.3.0 to 6.4.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#2351)</li>
  <li>Create Dependabot config file @dependabot-preview (#2350)</li>
  <li>Bump babel-plugin-relay from 10.1.2 to 10.1.3 in /ui @dependabot-preview (#2331)</li>
  <li>Bump react-jss from 10.5.0 to 10.5.1 in /ui @dependabot-preview (#2333)</li>
  <li>Bump fortio.org/fortio from 1.11.4 to 1.14.1 @dependabot-preview (#2320)</li>
  <li>Bump cypress from 6.2.0 to 6.4.0 in /ui @dependabot-preview (#2340)</li>
  <li>Bump eslint from 7.16.0 to 7.19.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot-preview (#2325)</li>
  <li>Bump jss from 10.5.0 to 10.5.1 in /provider-ui @dependabot-preview (#2326)</li>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.5.0-beta-3</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.0-beta-3">Released</a> on February 21, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>

<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Consider OS specific paths in system config CLIs @hexxdump (#2419)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] fix context support for all commands, clean-up @aneeshnema (#2412)</li>
  <li>[ImgBot] Optimize images @imgbot (#2423)</li>
  <li>Fixed formatting of minikube installation page @pranav-bhatt (#2416)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] refactor usage of <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">--context</code> flags for “context support” @navendu-pottekkat (#2408)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Feature: “context support” for system start command @navendu-pottekkat (#2407)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Bug Fix- <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">system start</code> fails to pull docker image if the version is not specified in the config.yaml file @navendu-pottekkat (#2405)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Feature: Added helper function for current-context support  @aneeshnema (#2397)</li>
  <li>Add support for meshmap metadata in patternfiles @utkarsh-pro (#2392)</li>
  <li>added documentation on meshsync,operator and database @kumarabd (#2381)</li>
  <li>docs: correct typo in minikube doc @subhamkrai (#2390)</li>
  <li>updated minikube docs @pranav-bhatt (#2387)</li>
  <li>Added Metabob entry in Adopters.md @chinmaym07 (#2378)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] platform support for kubernetes in <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">system start</code> (<code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">platform: kubernetes</code>) @navendu-pottekkat (#2365)</li>
  <li>Meshworks @utkarsh-pro (#2384)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Rework mesheryctl system channel to confirm to latest design and make it context and compose aware. Fixes #2246 @anirudhjain75 (#2256)</li>
  <li>Added support for remote Persistence of SMI data @dhruv0000 (#2371)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-features">🚀 Features</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Feature: MeshWorks and Patternfiles @leecalcote (#2339)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump billboard.js from 1.11.0 to 2.2.1 in /ui @dependabot-preview (#2332)</li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        if (parentCollapse) {

        }
      });
    });
  })();

           <h1>Meshery v0.5.0-beta-4</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.0-beta-4">Released</a> on February 22, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>

<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Revert “Bump billboard.js from 1.11.0 to 2.2.1 in /ui” @leecalcote (#2431)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] use current context endpoint when starting meshery @leecalcote (#2429)</li>
  <li>[Mesheryctl] Fix the meshery file path issues @hexxdump (#2427)</li>
  <li>Add Scoop instructions to docs site @alphaX86 (#2414)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Added mesheryctl installation instructions using homebrew @metonymic-smokey (#2410)</li>
  <li>[DOCS] Change Database diagram to new one and rename database SVG file @alphaX86 (#2424)</li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.5.0-rc-1</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.0-rc-1">Released</a> on February 22, 2021</h4>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.5.0-rc-5</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.0-rc-5">Released</a> on March 10, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>

<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Added edge release for plugins @kumarabd (#2522)</li>
  <li>Removed residues @kumarabd (#2518)</li>
  <li>Improvements @kumarabd (#2516)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Modified system config command to use go-client @hexxdump (#2513)</li>
  <li>fix for operator panic @kumarabd (#2512)</li>
  <li>fix for edge release @kumarabd (#2510)</li>
  <li>ui fix for panics @kumarabd (#2509)</li>
  <li>reverted to graphql resolvers @kumarabd (#2492)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] added update prompt @aneeshnema (#2505)</li>
  <li>removed extra line in the file verbose.yml @alonsolopezr (#2508)</li>
  <li>control plane dashboard @vineethvanga18 (#2506)</li>
  <li>Hook control plane with graphql @utkarsh-pro (#2504)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] platform: kubernetes support for <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">system stop</code> command @navendu-pottekkat (#2497)</li>
  <li>Update BillboardJS from v1 to v2 @dhruv0000 (#2494)</li>
  <li>[Docs] Instructions added to run Meshery-Istio in local enviroment @piyushsingariya (#2465)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] fixed system context commands, removed dependency on models/mesheryctl_config.go @aneeshnema (#2491)</li>
  <li>Minor changes @dhruv0000 (#2493)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Added adapters flag @metonymic-smokey (#2463)</li>
  <li>Fixed alignment of Meshery Sidebar with the Header @chinmaym07 (#2459)</li>
  <li>[UI] Fixes failing Docker build of UI @dhruv0000 (#2462)</li>
  <li>controlplane queries @vineethvanga18 (#2430)</li>
  <li>[Docs] Language separation for Functionality index @leecalcote (#2457)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Create dedicated section for tokens in default config @aneeshnema (#2436)</li>
  <li>Improve provider capabilities loading @utkarsh-pro (#2452)</li>
  <li>Improve context view command output @utkarsh-pro (#2443)</li>
  <li>[UI]: Fixes chip and paper card in /management @Nikhil-Ladha (#2446)</li>
  <li>Updated response for loadReqBasePath @dhruv0000 (#2418)</li>
  <li>Fixed: Header Overlapping with sidebar @chinmaym07 (#2445)</li>
  <li>Fixed error 404 on installation page @Anita-ihuman (#2441)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump github.com/meshery/meshkit from 0.2.0 to 0.2.3 @dependabot (#2487)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/prometheus/common from 0.15.0 to 0.18.0 @dependabot (#2483)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/spf13/cobra from 1.1.1 to 1.1.3 @dependabot (#2486)</li>
  <li>Bump js-yaml from 3.14.1 to 4.0.0 in /ui @dependabot (#2475)</li>
  <li>Bump caniuse-lite from 1.0.30001183 to 1.0.30001194 in /ui @dependabot (#2495)</li>
  <li>Bump react-lazyload from 3.1.0 to 3.2.0 in /ui @dependabot (#2474)</li>
  <li>Bump @babel/types from 7.12.13 to 7.13.0 in /ui @dependabot (#2477)</li>
  <li>Bump next from 10.0.6 to 10.0.7 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#2471)</li>
  <li>Bump cypress from 6.4.0 to 6.5.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#2469)</li>
  <li>Bump eslint from 7.19.0 to 7.21.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#2472)</li>
  <li>Bump @fortawesome/free-solid-svg-icons from 5.15.1 to 5.15.2 in /ui @dependabot (#2476)</li>
  <li>Bump eslint from 7.19.0 to 7.21.0 in /ui @dependabot (#2473)</li>
  <li>Bump husky from 4.3.8 to 5.1.2 in /ui @dependabot (#2470)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/sirupsen/logrus from 1.7.0 to 1.8.0 @dependabot (#2485)</li>
  <li>Bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.35.0 to 1.36.0 @dependabot (#2484)</li>
  <li>Bump notistack from 1.0.3 to 1.0.5 in /ui @dependabot (#2478)</li>
  <li>Bump codemirror from 5.59.2 to 5.59.4 in /ui @dependabot (#2468)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Added channel docs @metonymic-smokey (#2507)</li>
  <li>Jomefavourite#2304 @jomefavourite (#2388)</li>
  <li>Updated Suported Service Meshes table @bartkalanski (#2447)</li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.5.0-rc-6</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.0-rc-6">Released</a> on March 17, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>

<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Added versions for meshsync and broker controllers @kumarabd (#2566)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] consistent formatting of client and server version @aneeshnema (#2563)</li>
  <li>[meshery] Changes to meshery bash script for better user experience @hexxdump (#2554)</li>
  <li>Small ui fix for grafana boards @vineethvanga18 (#2562)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] platform: kubernetes support for <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">system status</code> command @navendu-pottekkat (#2550)</li>
  <li>Auto deploy for meshery operator @kumarabd (#2538)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Add –platform flag to <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">system context create</code> to support platform: kubernetes @navendu-pottekkat (#2559)</li>
  <li>Small ui change in prompt component @vineethvanga18 (#2555)</li>
  <li>Upgrade Relay to V11.0.0 and minor fixes @dhruv0000 (#2556)</li>
  <li>generic prompt component @vineethvanga18 (#2544)</li>
  <li>[CI] [integration] Cypress Testing for the “Discover Cluster” configuration @piyushsingariya (#2551)</li>
  <li>removed octarine from default listing @aneeshnema (#2545)</li>
  <li>consistent version and GIT SHA format @aneeshnema (#2552)</li>
  <li>Fix traefik mesh icon in the settings @utkarsh-pro (#2535)</li>
  <li>Temporarily removed nginx sm from meshery ui @utkarsh-pro (#2536)</li>
  <li>[docs] Add Meshery and mesheryctl roadmap into a ROADMAP.md file @navendu-pottekkat (#2525)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-bug-fixes">🐛 Bug Fixes</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Bug Fix] Minor fix for Relay 11.0.0 @dhruv0000 (#2564)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[CI][Integration] Cypress Testing for the “Service Mesh” configuration @piyushsingariya (#2466)</li>
  <li>Bump elliptic from 6.5.3 to 6.5.4 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#2517)</li>
  <li>Bump elliptic from 6.5.3 to 6.5.4 in /ui @dependabot (#2524)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>adding mesheryctl commands doc template @alonsolopezr (#2548)</li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.5.0</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.0">Released</a> on March 24, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>

<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>fix panic @kumarabd (#2587)</li>
  <li>changes meshery service port @s1ntaxe770r (#2585)</li>
  <li>Made Typography Left Align w/signoff @sestissi16 (#2586)</li>
  <li>fix minor bug @kumarabd (#2584)</li>
  <li>minor query modification @kumarabd (#2581)</li>
  <li>Cypress index page test @Maxgit3 (#2578)</li>
  <li>[WIP] Context command documentation @metonymic-smokey (#2571)</li>
  <li>[docs] Fix docs for installing Meshery on Minikube @navendu-pottekkat (#2574)</li>
  <li>minor fix @kumarabd (#2570)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] platform: kubernetes support for system update command and refactoring @navendu-pottekkat (#2569)</li>
  <li>prepopulate available namespaces at ‘/management’  @vineethvanga18 (#2523)</li>
  <li>Add support for performance profiles @utkarsh-pro (#2549)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] system reset platform(kubernetes) aware, refactoring @aneeshnema (#2560)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[CI] Conditional CI for mesheryctl  @aneeshnema (#2568)</li>
  <li>[GH Issue Template] Add issue template for mesheryctl and edit mesheryctl README @navendu-pottekkat (#2567)</li>
</ul>
 

   <br/>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.5.1</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.1">Released</a> on April 03, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>

<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Add support for patternfiles for default/none provider @utkarsh-pro (#2649)</li>
  <li>[meshery] Extend meshops.proto to provide adapter version, and other info @mgfeller (#2454)</li>
  <li>changes for the extensions flow @kumarabd (#2618)</li>
  <li>[MesheryAdapterPlayComponent] - Updated UI Card Margins On Management Page @adithyaakrishna (#2615)</li>
  <li>[WIP] K8s Pre-req check @metonymic-smokey (#2606)</li>
  <li>fix mesheryctl issue template @navendu-pottekkat (#2609)</li>
  <li>[WIP] Update Meshery results to follow SMP @navendu-pottekkat (#2605)</li>
  <li>bug fix for mesheryctl auto redireect @kumarabd (#2602)</li>
  <li>[Mesheryctl] Add “–yes” global flag to system commands @hexxdump (#2604)</li>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.5.11</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.11">Released</a> on May 07, 2021</h4>

<h3 id="whats-new">What’s new?</h3>

<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Updated the link to meshery releases @sanjana-98 (#2867)</li>
  <li>Resolved the overlapping of Divider line with the card border   @chinmaym07 (#2868)</li>
  <li>Added Asteria to Adopter  @samirparhi-dev (#2871)</li>
  <li>[MesheryUI] Added icons highlighting in header of meshery dashboard @NeelParihar (#2857)</li>
  <li>changed the local host port in aks installation @Anita-ihuman (#2840)</li>
  <li>Revert “Bump gorm.io/gorm from 1.20.10 to 1.21.9” @kumarabd (#2852)</li>
  <li>add icons to remote config @Tanuj22 (#2851)</li>
  <li>Fix meshkit dep go.sum entry @utkarsh-pro (#2846)</li>
  <li>Link fix for Mesheryctl in contribution.md @Chadha93 (#2848)</li>
  <li>MeshKit v0.2.9 @leecalcote (#2819)</li>
  <li>Disclose the CVE-2021-31856 in Meshery Docs under List of Announced Vulnerabilities @ssst0n3 (#2836)</li>
  <li>Re-enable Edge Release Workflow @ramrodo (#2832)</li>
  <li>[WIP] Automatically updating meshconfig file w/signoff @fallmor (#2816)</li>
  <li>change patternfile enpoint  @s1ntaxe770r (#2818)</li>
  <li>Add patterns list subcommand  @s1ntaxe770r (#2744)</li>
  <li>[Meshery] Add a check for validity of downloaded meshery.zip file @hexxdump (#2815)</li>
  <li>Added mesheryctl section in Docs @Chadha93 (#2813)</li>
  <li>[Fix]: Incorrect Path names in location field and add dedicated “branch” field @utkarsh-pro (#2814)</li>
  <li>Fix Release Notes Publisher workflow @ramrodo (#2811)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump ua-parser-js from 0.7.23 to 0.7.28 in /ui @dependabot (#2875)</li>
  <li>Bump @cypress/code-coverage from 3.9.4 to 3.9.5 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#2786)</li>
  <li>[CI] Migrate Action Trigger to Mesheryio GH org @leecalcote (#2817)</li>
  <li>[CI] Add GitHub action for labeler  @alphaX86 (#2812)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Meshkit errors exports @alonsolopezr (#2712)</li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.5.12</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.12">Released</a> on May 12, 2021</h4>

<h3 id="whats-new">What’s New</h3>

<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[WIP] Applying operator for docker on start and stop @metonymic-smokey (#2886)</li>
  <li>Update Meshery Filters @navendu-pottekkat (#2885)</li>
  <li>✅ Added missing bullet points(roadmap)[Docs] #2903 @vivekdhir77 (#2904)</li>
  <li>[Fix]: Server URL and Context List is empty when kubeconfig is autodetected @utkarsh-pro (#2892)</li>
  <li>Reverse in relation to issue #2866 @Anita-ihuman (#2894)</li>
  <li>Kumarabd/feature/addon @kumarabd (#2900)</li>
  <li>this fixeses issue for system contex view @samirparhi-dev (#2880)</li>
  <li>Added Filter UI file  @Chadha93 (#2882)</li>
  <li>nighthawk load testing @kumarabd (#2845)</li>
  <li>[README] Updated steps to access community drive @NeelParihar (#2862)</li>
  <li>Display endpoint based on platform @metonymic-smokey (#2761)</li>
  <li>Fixing operator lifecycle in system stop @metonymic-smokey (#2877)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Show the status of the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">meshery-broker</code> @piyushsingariya (#2878)</li>
  <li>Add Link Mesheryctl Command Reference @Vi1234sh12 (#2876)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-features">🚀 Features</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[mesheryctl] CRUD for WASM filters @piyushsingariya (#2821)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Invoke kubernetes checks independent of PreRunE and platform @piyushsingariya (#2891)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Merging <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">PreRunE</code> for command and <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">Preflight</code> checks @piyushsingariya (#2779)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump lodash from 4.17.19 to 4.17.21 in /ui @dependabot (#2895)</li>
  <li>Bump lodash from 4.17.19 to 4.17.21 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#2897)</li>
  <li>Bump hosted-git-info from 2.8.8 to 2.8.9 in /ui @dependabot (#2898)</li>
  <li>Bump underscore from 1.11.0 to 1.13.1 in /ui @dependabot (#2864)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[WIP] Updating docs about operator and endpoints @metonymic-smokey (#2899)</li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.5.13</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.13">Released</a> on May 17, 2021</h4>

<h3 id="whats-new">What’s New</h3>

<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Add skip-update flag on <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">system restart</code> cmd @alphaX86 (#2929)</li>
  <li>[UI] Icons scaled with all browser zoom in/out @Ayush-Khandelwal-007 (#2934)</li>
  <li>Updating table for docs @amino19 (#2950)</li>
  <li>Update system status and system logs @navendu-pottekkat (#2930)</li>
  <li>Fix system status and IsMesheryRunning @navendu-pottekkat (#2922)</li>
  <li>Fix system update for <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">platform: kubernetes</code> @navendu-pottekkat (#2926)</li>
  <li>Fix <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">system logs</code> @navendu-pottekkat (#2915)</li>
  <li>Apply operators conditionally based on commands @metonymic-smokey (#2916)</li>
  <li>Fixed bug with deploying Meshery operator on platform: Docker @navendu-pottekkat (#2914)</li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>
