        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.5.15</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.15">Released</a> on May 25, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>

<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[mesheryctl] (child) View Performance Profile’s Configuration … @fallmor (#2887)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Validating versions and gracefully handling invalid versions @metonymic-smokey (#2980)</li>
  <li>Fix <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">context create</code>: Use values from template context @navendu-pottekkat (#2998)</li>
  <li>Namespace drop box to be responsive @Ayush-Khandelwal-007 (#3006)</li>
  <li>Added Confirmation when Channel is Set @DARK-art108 (#3008)</li>
  <li>Config file input box visibility fix @Ayush-Khandelwal-007 (#3014)</li>
  <li>[Meshery UI] - Updated Meshery Provider UI @adithyaakrishna (#2927)</li>
  <li>Fixed doc commands in root makefile @dhruv0000 (#2999)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] system context list: improve msg for listing missing contexts @leecalcote (#2995)</li>
  <li>Tried to rectify the issue of docs build previews trigerring on mesheryctl-changes @chinmaym07 (#2967)</li>
  <li>[Docs] - Added Release Notes from v0.5.3 to v0.5.14 @adithyaakrishna (#2990)</li>
  <li>[UI] Navigation Menu Icon Scale with zoom in/out  @Ayush-Khandelwal-007 (#2966)</li>
  <li>Bump nokogiri from 1.11.1 to 1.11.5 in /docs @dependabot (#2987)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[CI] Makefile: <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">make docs</code> for conveniently building docs @leecalcote (#2993)</li>
  <li>[CI] Helm: Test of helm chart releaser for remote repo @leecalcote (#2982)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Docs] Contributing / Project / Overview section restructure @leecalcote (#3010)</li>
  <li>[Docs] Automatic Graphql Docs Generation @dhruv0000 (#2989)</li>
  <li>Add contributing guidelines for mesheryctl @navendu-pottekkat (#3007)</li>
  <li>[Docs] Service mesh pattern management @leecalcote (#2988)</li>
  <li>[Docs]: page for <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl system update</code> @Blakelist7 (#2974)</li>
  <li>[Docs] [WIP] Modify command reference doc pages @alphaX86 (#2985)</li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.5.18</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.18">Released</a> on June 03, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>

<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>

<ul>
  <li>refactor mesheryctl @navendu-pottekkat (#3115)</li>
  <li>release notes for v0.5.15,v0.5.16,v0.5.17 @umairnsr87 (#3130)</li>
  <li>[Patterns] Add support for deploying applications using meshery @utkarsh-pro (#3037)</li>
  <li>Workflow for deleting current context @metonymic-smokey (#3060)</li>
  <li>Kumarabd/feature/helm charts @kumarabd (#3076)</li>
  <li>[ImgBot] Optimize images @imgbot (#3088)</li>
  <li>Kuma Adapter URL fixed @debjani1413 (#3087)</li>
  <li>Fix time parsing issue in local provider @utkarsh-pro (#3080)</li>
  <li>Fix operator lifecycle for update and reset @metonymic-smokey (#3001)</li>
  <li>Added Filters and removed edit option @Chadha93 (#3073)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] List subcommand under mesheryctl perf @piyushsingariya (#2928)</li>
  <li>Revert “[Docs] mesheryctl: Create a subcommand for system logs, restart and reset” @adithyaakrishna (#3064)</li>
  <li>Add filters to database @navendu-pottekkat (#3062)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump fortio.org/fortio from 1.14.2 to 1.15.2 @dependabot (#3108)</li>
  <li>Bump @types/react-relay from 7.0.17 to 11.0.1 in /ui @dependabot (#3098)</li>
  <li>Bump react-relay from 11.0.0 to 11.0.2 in /ui @dependabot (#3101)</li>
  <li>Bump eslint-plugin-react from 7.23.2 to 7.24.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#3104)</li>
  <li>Bump notistack from 1.0.6 to 1.0.9 in /ui @dependabot (#3106)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/vektah/gqlparser/v2 from 2.1.0 to 2.2.0 @dependabot (#3107)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/prometheus/common from 0.23.0 to 0.25.0 @dependabot (#3109)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/lib/pq from 1.10.1 to 1.10.2 @dependabot (#3111)</li>
  <li>Bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.37.0 to 1.38.0 @dependabot (#3114)</li>
  <li>Bump start-server-and-test from 1.12.1 to 1.12.3 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#3100)</li>
  <li>Bump cypress from 7.2.0 to 7.4.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#3099)</li>
  <li>Bump eslint-plugin-cypress from 2.11.2 to 2.11.3 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#3096)</li>
  <li>Bump next from 10.2.0 to 10.2.3 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#3102)</li>
  <li>Fix “Service Meshes” e2e test @ramrodo (#3119)</li>
  <li>Bump relay-compiler from 10.1.3 to 11.0.2 in /ui @dependabot (#3092)</li>
  <li>Bump husky from 5.1.2 to 6.0.0 in /ui @dependabot (#3105)</li>
  <li>Bump @cypress/code-coverage from 3.9.5 to 3.9.6 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#3097)</li>
  <li>Bump cypress from 6.8.0 to 7.4.0 in /ui @dependabot (#3095)</li>
  <li>Bump @fortawesome/free-regular-svg-icons from 5.15.2 to 5.15.3 in /ui @dependabot (#3093)</li>
  <li>Bump js-yaml from 4.0.0 to 4.1.0 in /ui @dependabot (#3091)</li>
  <li>Bump eslint-plugin-cypress from 2.11.2 to 2.11.3 in /ui @dependabot (#3090)</li>
  <li>Bump eslint from 7.25.0 to 7.27.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#3094)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/meshery/meshkit from 0.2.10 to 0.2.11 @dependabot (#3112)
[CI] Remove unused hooks for Docker image building @leecalcote (#3056)</li>
  <li>Fix Release Notes Drafter @ramrodo (#3055)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.5.2</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.2">Released</a> on April 08, 2021</h4>

<h3 id="whats-new">What’s new?</h3>

<ul>
  <li>
    <p>General</p>

    <ul>
      <li>Fixes 404 for invalid id and gostatic lint suggestions @aneeshnema</li>
      <li>Updates Lint @ramrodo</li>
      <li>Organizing the start of user guides @leecalcote (#2653)</li>
      <li>Moved support for pattern command directly under mesheryctl @piyushsingariya (#2654)</li>
      <li>Fix Relese Drafter @ramrodo (#2655)</li>
      <li>Replace the install steps to follow the style of Atifact Hub @Aisuko (#2659)</li>
      <li>Removed usage/help when platform not available @metonymic-smokey (#2660)</li>
      <li>Fix Pattern Search For Remote Provider @utkarsh-pro (#2663)</li>
      <li>[mesheryctl] system restart command deletes the pods on meshery namespace and leave the services running @piyushsingariya (#2666)</li>
      <li>[mesheryctl] Removed context command from experimental @piyushsingariya (#2667)</li>
      <li>Updated Font Size of Meshery Welcome Screen @adithyaakrishna (#2670)</li>
      <li>[CI] mesheryctl: ignore publishing of ARM6 + Windows combo @leecalcote (#2673)</li>
      <li>[mesheryctl][k8s] Minor changes for system restart in logs @piyushsingariya (#2676)</li>
      <li>[meshery] return 404 when api/experimental/patternfile/id fetched with invalid id @aneeshnema (#2679)</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ul>
 

   <br/>


        </div>
      </main>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.20">Released</a> on June 09, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>

<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Tooltip UI for Load generators @DantrazTrev (#3129)</li>
  <li>Handle API key change in Grafana Marics Settings @Ayush-Khandelwal-007 (#3157)</li>
  <li>[Docs] update instructions for upgrading meshery docker deployment @DelusionalOptimist (#3155)</li>
  <li>Fixed handleOperatorClick chip @dhruv0000 (#3146)</li>
  <li>fixes for operator flow @kumarabd (#3147)</li>
  <li>fix[UI]: Make Meshery logo stick to the top in Navigator @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3133)</li>
  <li>Fix the user Profile shifting issue in Meshery UI @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3144)</li>
  <li>Allow users to set channel as stable-vX.X.X @metonymic-smokey (#3148)</li>
  <li>Fixed channel set panic @metonymic-smokey (#3145)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>

</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {
  var url = "https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=meshery/meshery";
  fetch(url, {

  }).then(function(e) {

  }).then(function(r) {
     console.log(r.items[0])
     stars = r.items[0]['stargazers_count']
     forks = r.items[0]['forks_count']
     $('#stars').text(stars + " Stars")
     $('#forks').text(forks + " Forks")
  });

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.5.24</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.24">Released</a> on June 18, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Fix Meshery logo click behaviour @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3225)</li>
  <li>fix edge channel deployments @navendu-pottekkat (#3233)</li>
  <li>[Bug fix] Fixed <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">dataFetch</code> catching error when getting Grafana Boards @dhruv0000 (#3220)</li>
  <li>change service port @s1ntaxe770r (#3224)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Wait for pods to terminate on <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">system stop</code> @navendu-pottekkat (#3227)</li>
  <li>meshery fixes for kubeconfig @kumarabd (#3228)</li>
  <li>switch provider package to edge-latest @kumarabd (#3221)</li>
  <li>Kumarabd/feature/broker @kumarabd (#3219)</li>
  <li>changes for kubeconfig validation @kumarabd (#3191)</li>
  <li>Moved swagger.yaml to /helpers @piyushsingariya (#3211)</li>
  <li>[ui] Update grammar in operator removal message @josephmidura (#3188)</li>
  <li>Fix #3192: Fix installation steps in mesheryctl bash file @Abhishek-kumar09 (#3193)</li>
  <li>Update README.md: Fix meshery badges @amino19 (#3194)</li>
  <li>Add dynamic Management Pane UI @utkarsh-pro (#3202)</li>
  <li>Added imports for remote provider extensions @Ayush-Khandelwal-007 (#3203)</li>
  <li>Added Application UI @Chadha93 (#3186)</li>
  <li>Reverted <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">gqlpraser</code>, Addon Resolvers Fix and added Make commands @dhruv0000 (#3181)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl perf</code> subcommands @piyushsingariya (#3082)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Added <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl exp application</code> @piyushsingariya (#3170)</li>
  <li>Fix Netlify builds @ramrodo (#3179)</li>
  <li>operator panic fix @kumarabd (#3172)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-bug-fixes">🐛 Bug Fixes</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Docs] - Fixed CI Failing Issue Due to Error in Syntax of Main FIle @adithyaakrishna (#3190)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Update CodeCov report configuration @ramrodo (#3177)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>docs and make updated for error utils @kumarabd (#3216)</li>
  <li>[Docs] <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl system mesh validate</code> page added @amino19 (#3149)</li>
  <li>Added the new releases of meshery to Docs @iambami (#3196)</li>
  <li>[Docs] - Fixed CI Failing Issue Due to Error in Syntax of Main FIle @adithyaakrishna (#3190)</li>
  <li>[Docs] - Added status command files @umairnsr87 (#3086)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @Ayush-Khandelwal-007, @Chadha93, @adithyaakrishna, @amino19, @dhruv0000, @iambami, @josephmidura, @kumarabd, @leecalcote, @navendu-pottekkat, @piyushsingariya, @ramrodo, @s1ntaxe770r, @sudo-NithishKarthik, @umairnsr87 and @utkarsh-pro</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.5.26</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.26">Released</a> on June 24, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[UI]Update remote-component.config.js @killbotXD (#3249)</li>
  <li>Partial Bugfix for #3245 ( Kubernetes part ) @anirudhjain75 (#3252)</li>
  <li>MeshKit errors for Handlers + bug fixes @dhruv0000 (#3263)</li>
  <li>margins for menu items adjusted @Ayush-Khandelwal-007 (#3261)</li>
  <li>CRUD for applications @navendu-pottekkat (#3213)</li>
  <li>Fix for Grafana breaking changes in v7.4 + minor bug fixes  @dhruv0000 (#3247)</li>
  <li>[Meshery] Handle the temp directory creation/deletion for mac OS @hexxdump (#3242)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Unit Testing Setup @piyushsingariya (#3137)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Updated Jekyll tutorial to Meshery Documentation @debjani1413 (#3116)</li>
  <li>updated performance docs @NagaHarshita (#3218)</li>
  <li>[Docs] Fix and cleanup issues in Meshery docs @alphaX86 (#3229)</li>
  <li>[Roadmap] Adding milestone hyperlinks @leecalcote (#3265)</li>
  <li>[Docs] Updated contributing docs for better instructions to compile and run meshery server from source @pranav-bhatt (#3236)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Ayush-Khandelwal-007, @NagaHarshita, @alphaX86, @anirudhjain75, @debjani1413, @dhruv0000, @hexxdump, @killbotXD, @kumarabd, @leecalcote, @navendu-pottekkat, @piyushsingariya and @pranav-bhatt</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.5.27</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.27">Released</a> on June 30, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>

<ul>
  <li>test meshery build code @nehaLohia27 (#3301)</li>
  <li>netlify build code for meshery repo @nehaLohia27 (#3300)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Minor fix for  <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl system status</code> @piyushsingariya (#3298)</li>
  <li>REST API and GraphQL docs @kaushambisharma (#3294)</li>
  <li>contributing meshery errors updated @kumarabd (#3289)</li>
  <li>update workflows to reflect meshery repo change @navendu-pottekkat (#3290)</li>
  <li>Refactor some part of helpers and split into related packages
   @anirudhjain75 (#3259)</li>
  <li>Open API Docs #3 @piyushsingariya (#3173)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">perf apply</code> Performance-id replaced with performance-name @piyushsingariya (#3254)</li>
  <li>Add support for JSONSchema Draft4 in RJSF @utkarsh-pro (#3278)</li>
  <li>Adds a New Line for the finalMSG @DantrazTrev (#3264)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump normalize-url from 4.5.0 to 4.5.1 in /provider-ui @dependabot   (#3292)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Open API Docs #2 @piyushsingariya (#3075)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@DantrazTrev, @Nikhil-Ladha, @anirudhjain75, @dependabot, @dependabo[bot], @dhruv0000, @kaushambisharma, @kumarabd, @leecalcote,@navendu-pottekkat, @nehaLohia27, @piyushsingariya and @utkarsh-pro</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.5.3</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.3">Released</a> on April 28, 2021</h4>

<h3 id="whats-new">What’s New</h3>

<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[Docs] - Added Releases from v0.4.23 to v0.5.1 @adithyaakrishna (#2756)</li>
  <li>Meshery Operator - Lifecycle Management @metonymic-smokey (#2736)</li>
  <li>Add “order by” query sanitization @utkarsh-pro (#2745)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl exp preflight</code> to verify environment readiness for a Meshery deloyment @piyushsingariya (#2743)</li>
  <li>[Docs] - Fixes Date Issue in v0.4.2 @adithyaakrishna (#2755)</li>
  <li>[Docs] - Added Release Notes for v0.5.2 and Changed Casing @adithyaakrishna (#2753)</li>
  <li>Bug Fixes @dhruv0000 (#2742)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] update the roadmap of mesheryctl @hexxdump (#2746)</li>
  <li>Added Examples for Request Header Fields @adithyaakrishna (#2739)</li>
  <li>docs(roadmap): add an entry for meshery v0.5.0 @bnbjin (#2735)</li>
  <li>add icons to remote component config  @Tanuj22 (#2732)</li>
  <li>[UI] Add commas to one thousandth place @Kn99HN (#2725)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Added <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">pattern view</code> @aneeshnema (#2671)</li>
  <li>Prerequisite added for testing Go code. #Issue 2588 @sakshi3537 (#2721)</li>
  <li>Fixed Flip Card Animation in Big Sur @utkarsh-pro (#2720)</li>
  <li>Correct links in Doc pages @alphaX86 (#2719)</li>
  <li>Deleting resources on system stop @metonymic-smokey (#2695)</li>
  <li>Add API for importing pattern files from github @utkarsh-pro (#2705)</li>
  <li>Include UserID in the patterns reponse JSON @utkarsh-pro (#2718)</li>
  <li>fixes for cases listed below @kumarabd (#2715)</li>
  <li>[Mesheryctl] Added list to context @Kn99HN (#2713)</li>
  <li>[Mesheryctl] Update comments for system command @Kn99HN (#2714)</li>
  <li>Few updates to the UI contributing guide @Nikhil-Ladha (#2703)</li>
  <li>Fix the CI of lint chart @Aisuko (#2707)</li>
  <li>Add customize way to choice deploy the meshery adapters @Aisuko (#2664)</li>
  <li>[Mesheryctl][Kubernetes] Replace <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">latest</code> with exact version after fetching manifest files @piyushsingariya (#2662)</li>
  <li>Added a section for WebAssembly filter in the README @Abiola-Farounbi (#2706)</li>
  <li>Added GraphQL Docs @dhruv0000 (#2704)</li>
  <li>[WIP][Meshery] Fix Kube API authentication issue with GKE @hexxdump (#2674)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[CI] Helm Chart Releaser Workflow: update helm chart location @leecalcote (#2757)</li>
  <li>[Security] Static analysis using CodeQL @leecalcote (#2650)</li>
  <li>Add the CI for auto release the Helm chart @Aisuko (#2675)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/prometheus/common from 0.18.0 to 0.20.0 @dependabot (#2685)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/golang/protobuf from 1.4.3 to 1.5.2 @dependabot (#2688)</li>
  <li>Bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.36.0 to 1.37.0 @dependabot (#2687)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/lib/pq from 1.7.0 to 1.10.0 @dependabot (#2690)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/olekukonko/tablewriter from 0.0.2 to 0.0.5 @dependabot (#2691)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/qri-io/jsonschema from 0.2.0 to 0.2.1 @dependabot (#2694)</li>
  <li>Separate into two workflows the release drafter and the release notes jobs @ramrodo (#2697)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/meshery/meshery-operator from 0.2.11 to 0.2.12 @dependabot (#2689)</li>
  <li>Bump fortio.org/fortio from 1.14.1 to 1.14.2 @dependabot (#2686)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/prometheus/client_golang from 1.9.0 to 1.10.0 @dependabot (#2693)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/Mesheryio/nighthawk-go from 0.1.5 to 0.1.6 @dependabot (#2692)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>add v0.5.0 to mesheryctl roadmap @Micost (#2734)</li>
  <li>Update Broken Link at Meshery Docs NGINX-SM Page @adithyaakrishna (#2727)</li>
  <li>Create Individual doc pages (WIP) @alphaX86 (#2665)</li>
  <li>README: Update the SMP screenshot @Anita-ihuman (#2710)</li>
  <li>A brief proposal for the manage of Error code Reference @alonsolopezr (#2702)</li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })

      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.5.30</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.30">Released</a> on July 02, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>meshkit errors added @kumarabd (#3370)</li>
  <li>Open API Docs #4 @piyushsingariya (#3342)</li>
  <li>Remove the configuration of helm-releaser that we no longer need @Aisuko (#3364)</li>
  <li>Upgraded grafana sdk and some Grafana :bug: fixes @dhruv0000 (#3357)</li>
  <li>Updated the link for help-wanted label @sayantan1413 (#3358)</li>
  <li>Added the custom action needed for the Netlify workflow @Nikhil-Ladha (#3338)</li>
  <li>Patterns Meshsync interrelation @utkarsh-pro (#3262)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/prometheus/common from 0.25.0 to 0.29.0 @dependabot (#3332)</li>
  <li>Upgraded from  (deprecated) to  query for  @dhruv0000 (#3299)</li>
  <li>[UI] Create confirmation modal for test profile delete  @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3340)</li>
  <li>Updated the meshkit error for user handler @sayantan1413 (#3283)</li>
  <li>Updated slack.yml @debjani1413 (#3339)</li>
  <li>[ImgBot] Optimize images @imgbot (#3205)</li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.5.32</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.32">Released</a> on July 09, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Fix RJSF stale state issue @utkarsh-pro (#3418)</li>
  <li>Add login and logout command to mesheryctl @utkarsh-pro (#3396)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/meshery/meshsync from 0.1.21 to 0.1.23 @dhruv0000 (#3416)</li>
  <li>Changed the port , added prefix and the namespace into the istio yml @samirparhi-dev (#3232)</li>
  <li>broker connection issue fixed for plugins @kumarabd (#3403)</li>
  <li>[UI] New Notification Design implementation @jeantiston (#3197)</li>
  <li>Gracefully handling invalid meshconfig errors @metonymic-smokey (#3198)</li>
  <li>E2E demo plugins @killbotXD (#3404)</li>
  <li>[Chore] Update in  roadmap @piyushsingariya (#3392)</li>
  <li>Actions Enhancement for Meshery Patterns @Chadha93 (#3345)</li>
  <li>Updated the meshkit error for schedule_handler.go  @Shreyas220 (#3384)</li>
  <li>Updated the meshkit error for load_test_meshes_handler.go  @debjani1413 (#3381)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Docs] Release Notes for Meshery v0.5.32 @l5io (#3388)</li>
  <li>[Unit Testing] Unit Testing for  @piyushsingariya (#3288)</li>
  <li>“move codecov from root to .github” @suhaniii (#3377)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[README] add: Community Forum @amino19 (#3272)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Aisuko, @Chadha93, @Nikhil-Ladha, @Shreyas220, @amino19, @debjani1413, @dhruv0000, @hexxdump, @jeantiston, @killbotXD, @kumarabd, @l5io, @leecalcote, @metonymic-smokey, @navendu-pottekkat, @piyushsingariya, @samirparhi-dev, @suhaniii, @utkarsh-pro and l5io</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>
