<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

  }).then(function(e) {
    return e.json()
  }).then(function(r) {
     console.log(r.items[0])
     stars = r.items[0]['stargazers_count']
     forks = r.items[0]['forks_count']
     $('#stars').text(stars + " Stars")
     $('#forks').text(forks + " Forks")
  });
});
</script>
meshery-custom-end -->

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.34">Released</a> on July 10, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s new</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Reverted backup for empty meshconfig @metonymic-smokey (#3439)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Fix for system login @piyushsingariya (#3433)</li>
  <li>Open API Docs #5 @piyushsingariya (#3368)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@metonymic-smokey, @navendu-pottekkat, @piyushsingariya, @ramrodo and @utkarsh-pro</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.5.37</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.37">Released</a> on July 14, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Fix  @DelusionalOptimist (#3449)</li>
  <li>[UI] Naming fix for Patterns, Applications, Filters @Chadha93 (#3448)</li>
  <li>Bump addressable from 2.7.0 to 2.8.0 in /docs @dependabot (#3494)</li>
  <li>Add  endpoint to serve the filter file @navendu-pottekkat (#3467)</li>
  <li>[UI] Application actions and endpoints envoked @Chadha93 (#3464)</li>
  <li>Nithish/pattern UI imp @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3455)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Updated docker/k8s conflict in  @piyushsingariya (#3491)</li>
  <li>[CI] Open API Specification and Documentation workflow @amino19 (#3239)</li>
  <li>Bump billboard.js from 3.0.3 to 3.1.2 @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3465)</li>
  <li>Changed Notification Message Wrapping and Bell Button On Click @jeantiston (#3460)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Fixing docker/k8s conflict incase of platform docker @piyushsingariya (#3490)</li>
  <li>updates meshkit error for load test handler @warunicorn19 (#3371)</li>
  <li>Profile cards changes @Ayush-Khandelwal-007 (#3454)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[mesheryctl] system  and  Integration Testing @piyushsingariya (#3430)</li>
  <li>skip workflow run on forks @iamsdas (#3432)</li>
  <li>Updated the meshkit error for performance_profiles_handler and provider_handler @Shreyas220 (#3397)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Fix for  Not Set in stable releases @piyushsingariya (#3461)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Docs] - Refactored Old Docs with Emoji @adithyaakrishna (#3457)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Ayush-Khandelwal-007, @Chadha93, @DelusionalOptimist, @Shreyas220, @adithyaakrishna, @amino19, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @dhruv0000, @iamsdas, @jeantiston, @kumarabd, @leecalcote, @navendu-pottekkat, @piyushsingariya, @ramrodo, @sudo-NithishKarthik and @warunicorn19</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.5.38</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.38">Released</a> on July 14, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>update go-version in CI doc @navendu-pottekkat (#3582)</li>
  <li>Updated UI to show SMI version @dhruv0000 (#3580)</li>
  <li>graphql refactor @kumarabd (#3567)</li>
  <li>[Meshery] Reworking <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">/experiment/pattern</code> endpoints @piyushsingariya (#3542)</li>
  <li>@vijcheru Called Meshkit Error Handler instead of Logrus @vijcheru (#3387)</li>
  <li>[Mesheryctl] server_spec_handler (meshkit) @Chadha93 (#3561)</li>
  <li>[Mesheryctl] session_sync_handler (meshkit) @Chadha93 (#3560)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] fix: Added description for the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">system logs</code> command @muskankhedia (#3284)</li>
  <li>Sets default value for namespace in management page @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3564)</li>
  <li>Add settings page path to exportPathMap @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3548)</li>
  <li>Fix indentation problem in label commentor workflow file @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3552)</li>
  <li>Issue #3401/Added field token-location in meshery system context view @Revolyssup (#3408)</li>
  <li>refactor mesheryctl 1 - Add getters and setters to config and refactor start.go @navendu-pottekkat (#3546)</li>
  <li>use latest version of error codes utility in the err-codes-updater workflow @DelusionalOptimist (#3539)</li>
  <li>[UI] Pass remote provider page titles verbatim @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3532)</li>
  <li>Migrated errors for models package #2 @dhruv0000 (#3528)</li>
  <li>fix for prometheus connectivity bug @kumarabd (#3537)</li>
  <li>updated Validator.go @Shreyas220 (#3533)</li>
  <li>mesheryctl features @kumarabd (#3514)</li>
  <li>fix broken dependency @killbotXD (#3526)</li>
  <li>creating issue/remind label text @Anita-ihuman (#3523)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl pattern apply -f &lt;github-url&gt;</code> @piyushsingariya (#3489)</li>
  <li>Add icon dependencies for remote provider  @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3519)</li>
  <li>[UI]add duplicate button @killbotXD (#3524)</li>
  <li>[Fix]Re-enable support for patterns, filters and applications in local provider @utkarsh-pro (#3515)</li>
  <li>Updated bitcask smiresultss persister @Shreyas220 (#3509)</li>
  <li>Upgraded the meshkit error for helpers directory @sayantan1413 (#3506)</li>
  <li>Migrated errors for <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">models</code> package @dhruv0000 (#3505)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] channel switch: update in confirmation verbiage @leecalcote (#3507)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[CI] Upgrade Meshery to Golang 1.16 @leecalcote (#3556)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Tests for <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl system status</code> @piyushsingariya (#3541)</li>
  <li>perf: Delete the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">apt-get</code> lists after installing something @iamrajiv (#3535)</li>
  <li>[CI] error codes utility runner workflow @DelusionalOptimist (#3527)</li>
  <li>creating issue/dco check label text @Anita-ihuman (#3529)</li>
  <li>[CI] Add ignore paths for notify providers @iamsdas (#3521)</li>
  <li>adding alias for bitcask repo @nitinosiris (#3516)</li>
  <li>[CI] Add label and function for <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">component/mesheryctl</code> @alphaX86 (#3499)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Restored satrt as it was intended @nitinosiris (#3572)</li>
  <li>Add Docs regarding writing Unit and Integration Testing @ishitakeshawani (#3557)</li>
  <li>typo fixed @nitinosiris (#3551)</li>
  <li>updated the wide mobile view @warunicorn19 (#3452)</li>
  <li>Fix typo in the contributing-guidelines page @Anand-Theertha (#3502)</li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.5.39</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.39">Released</a> on July 25, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Revert dynamic provider version @utkarsh-pro (#3647)</li>
  <li>remove codeowners @navendu-pottekkat (#3646)</li>
  <li>Issue #3508/ added token command for CRUD operations @Revolyssup (#3522)</li>
  <li>[UI] Filters: Action Enhancements @Chadha93 (#3638)</li>
  <li>Add support for custom callback URL in meshery server @utkarsh-pro (#3544)</li>
  <li>Fix mesheryctl pattern delete @utkarsh-pro (#3633)</li>
  <li>Error2/debjani1413 @kumarabd (#3609)</li>
  <li>Kumarabd/feature/ci @kumarabd (#3603)</li>
  <li>[UI] Changed labels on settings button @sayantan1413 (#3579)</li>
  <li>[Security] Provider UI: CVE-2020-28469 @leecalcote (#3604)</li>
  <li>Fix mesheryctl lint errors @navendu-pottekkat (#3602)</li>
  <li>Adding mesheryctl errors to meshkit errors @metonymic-smokey (#3545)</li>
  <li>[Docs] REST API:  endpoint @piyushsingariya (#3412)</li>
  <li>mesheryctl refactor 3 @navendu-pottekkat (#3592)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Bump gorm.io/gorm from 1.20.10 to 1.21.12 @dependabot (#3623)</li>
  <li>Bump immutable from 4.0.0-rc.12 to 4.0.0-rc.14 in /ui @dependabot (#3629)</li>
  <li>Bump codemirror from 5.59.4 to 5.62.2 in /ui @dependabot (#3627)</li>
  <li>Bump start-server-and-test from 1.12.6 to 1.13.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#3616)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/meshery/meshery-operator from 0.2.19 to 0.2.20 @dependabot (#3625)</li>
  <li>[CI] Updated the meshkit utility runner for the mesheryctl error codes @sayantan1413 (#3611)</li>
  <li>Bump start-server-and-test from 1.12.5 to 1.13.0 in /ui @dependabot (#3621)</li>
  <li>Bump eslint from 7.30.0 to 7.31.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#3614)</li>
  <li>Bump glob-parent from 5.1.2 to 6.0.1 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#3617)</li>
  <li>Bump @types/react-relay from 11.0.1 to 11.0.2 in /ui @dependabot (#3630)</li>
  <li>Bump @cypress/code-coverage from 3.9.7 to 3.9.9 in /ui @dependabot (#3622)</li>
  <li>Bump @material-ui/core from 4.12.1 to 4.12.2 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#3612)</li>
  <li>Bump eslint from 7.29.0 to 7.31.0 in /ui @dependabot (#3615)</li>
  <li>Bump cypress from 7.7.0 to 8.0.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#3618)</li>
  <li>Bump @rjsf/material-ui from 2.5.1 to 3.0.0 in /ui @dependabot (#3619)</li>
  <li>Bump nodemon from 2.0.10 to 2.0.12 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#3620)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/vektah/gqlparser/v2 from 2.1.0 to 2.2.0 @dependabot (#3624)</li>
  <li>Bump @babel/types from 7.14.0 to 7.14.8 in /ui @dependabot (#3631)</li>
  <li>Bump @date-io/moment from 2.10.11 to 2.11.0 in /ui @dependabot (#3632)</li>
  <li>Bump husky from 7.0.0 to 7.0.1 in /ui @dependabot (#3628)</li>
  <li>Bump github.com/spf13/cobra from 1.1.3 to 1.2.1 @dependabot (#3626)</li>
  <li>Bump @cypress/code-coverage from 3.9.8 to 3.9.9 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#3613)</li>
  <li>Fix import path for bitcask @prologic (#3596)</li>
  <li>Separate CI build test for meshery and provider UI @iamsdas (#3503)</li>
  <li>Updated the mesheryctl workflow script to fix the forked repo workflow trigger issue @samirparhi-dev (#3583)</li>
  <li>Bump glob-parent from 3.1.0 to 5.1.2 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#3607)</li>
  <li>[CI] Docs: escape liquid tags @leecalcote (#3605)</li>
  <li>update golint to revive @navendu-pottekkat (#3601)</li>
  <li>[CI] bump golanglint version to 1.41.x @leecalcote (#3591)</li>
  <li>update goreleaser-action version in the workflow @navendu-pottekkat (#3593)</li>
  <li>updated golang version in dockerfile @warunicorn19 (#3589)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[DOCS] meshery UI contributing @bariqhibat (#3594)</li>
  <li>Updating the error docs @Shreyas220 (#3512)</li>
  <li>[CI] Docs: escape liquid tags @leecalcote (#3605)</li>
  <li>Correct redirection of the links @Anand-Theertha (#3598)</li>
  <li>Added documentation of some features in the contributing docs @debjani1413 (#3587)</li>
  <li>made error codes component table mobile friendly @debo19 (#3575)</li>
  <li>[Docs] Contributing: Breaking out Meshery Server into separate page @leecalcote (#3577)</li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.5.40</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.40">Released</a> on July 27, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>patch NavigatetoBrowser for missing xdg-open @navendu-pottekkat (#3665)</li>
  <li>added swagger api video link to docs @warunicorn19 (#3663)</li>
  <li>added check for docker or kubernetes platform @nehaLohia27 (#3562)</li>
  <li>Migrated GraphQL resolver logic to models @dhruv0000 (#3652)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Added PreRunE Health Checks for multiple system commands @piyushsingariya (#3649)</li>
  <li>Open API Docs /system endpoint @piyushsingariya (#3641)</li>
  <li>[UI] Bulk selection and delete operation in Filters UI  @Chadha93 (#3650)</li>
  <li>Update Maintainer.md @sayantan1413 (#3648)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Docs] Open API: Provider endpoint @piyushsingariya (#3578)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Chadha93, @Nikhil-Ladha, @dhruv0000, @leecalcote, @navendu-pottekkat, @nehaLohia27, @piyushsingariya, @sayantan1413 and @warunicorn19</p>
 

   <br/>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.5.41</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.41">Released</a> on July 28, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Upgraded to meshkit error @sayantan1413 (#3610)</li>
  <li>Revert “[UI] block fetch to grafana or prometheus if not configured” @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3677)</li>
  <li>system start fails with empty platform flag @nehaLohia27 (#3675)</li>
  <li>added meshery operator logo to docs @debo19 (#3676)</li>
  <li>changed the message to view the status of pods @guptapriyanshu7 (#3672)</li>
  <li>[UI] block fetch to grafana or prometheus if not configured @bariqhibat (#3595)</li>
  <li>[Docs] Custom Callback @utkarsh-pro (#3655)</li>
  <li>[CI] Fixed the lint failure @sayantan1413 (#3669)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Unit tests for <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">system context</code> @Revolyssup (#3555)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

     forks = r.items[0]['forks_count']
     $('#stars').text(stars + " Stars")
     $('#forks').text(forks + " Forks")
  });
});
</script>
meshery-custom-end -->

           <h1>Meshery v0.5.42</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.42">Released</a> on August 04, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>MeshSync DB fix @dhruv0000 (#3775)</li>
  <li>Delete extra golden file in testdata @alphaX86 (#3772)</li>
  <li>Added SSE client for CLI to wait for operation to end @dhruv0000 (#3689)</li>
  <li>Changed the test file name @Revolyssup (#3767)</li>
  <li>[Docs] REST API: <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">/system</code> endpoint @piyushsingariya (#3518)</li>
  <li>[Fixes] Version Card Fix @dhruv0000 (#3763)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Fix for <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">perf view</code> @piyushsingariya (#3762)</li>
  <li>Added <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">User Data</code> and <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">User Pref</code> in HTTP request context @dhruv0000 (#3753)</li>
  <li>fix whitespace in GraphQL API workflow @DelusionalOptimist (#3752)</li>
  <li>[UI] Change the dev server script to use node rather than nodemon @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3750)</li>
  <li>[GraphQL] Added Token to Req context @dhruv0000 (#3748)</li>
  <li>[meshery] fix bug docker couldnt find swagger.yaml @bariqhibat (#3644)</li>
  <li>Handled closing for <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">listenToControlPlaneState</code> Subscription @dhruv0000 (#3741)</li>
  <li>Fix SSE for perf-test @dhruv0000 (#3742)</li>
  <li>Migrating system stop to meshkit style errors @metonymic-smokey (#3693)</li>
  <li>Fix duplicate env vars issue @utkarsh-pro (#3717)</li>
  <li>[DOCS] add fix bug for key/value size invalid  @bariqhibat (#3713)</li>
  <li>[UI] UI enhancements (Bulk operations) @Chadha93 (#3718)</li>
  <li>[Extension] dependency-addition @Chadha93 (#3716)</li>
  <li>Add subcommand app @suhaniii (#3540)</li>
  <li>Fix for Perf Test getting invoked @dhruv0000 (#3710)</li>
  <li>changed the messages for controlplane and meshsync @warunicorn19 (#3711)</li>
  <li>Fix UI handler behaviour @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3705)</li>
  <li>[meshery]meshery bash script to allow installation of cli alone @hexxdump (#3692)</li>
  <li>ui: Align adapter cards and make it vertically even @Abhishek-kumar09 (#3695)</li>
  <li>ui: Change Navigator Design according to latest requirements @Abhishek-kumar09 (#3581)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Gracefully handle errors when platform is unavailable @alphaX86 (#3585)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] fixes in <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">system check</code> @piyushsingariya (#3666)</li>
  <li>update to pkg/browser to open URLs @navendu-pottekkat (#3682)</li>
  <li>Connection Wizard @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3501)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Add GET request step in HealthCheck @alphaX86 (#3495)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl]Check for Meshery server status before opening in browser @hexxdump (#3685)</li>
  <li>Fix application workload JSON schema @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3686)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Backup meshconfig: Version fixes @metonymic-smokey (#3463)</li>
  <li>meshery: Fix read operation not waiting for user input @Abhishek-kumar09 (#3681)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[CI] notify remote providers only on stable releases  @DelusionalOptimist (#3766)</li>
  <li>chore(deps): bump github.com/prometheus/common from 0.29.0 to 0.30.0 @dependabot (#3736)</li>
  <li>chore(deps-dev): bump cypress from 7.6.0 to 8.1.0 in /ui @dependabot (#3729)</li>
  <li>chore(deps): bump @cypress/code-coverage from 3.9.9 to 3.9.10 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#3728)</li>
  <li>chore(deps-dev): bump nodemon from 2.0.9 to 2.0.12 in /ui @dependabot (#3720)</li>
  <li>chore(deps): bump @material-ui/core from 4.12.2 to 4.12.3 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#3723)</li>
  <li>chore(deps-dev): bump @babel/types from 7.14.8 to 7.14.9 in /ui @dependabot (#3721)</li>
  <li>chore(deps-dev): bump start-server-and-test from 1.13.0 to 1.13.1 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#3725)</li>
  <li>chore(deps-dev): bump eslint from 7.31.0 to 7.32.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#3730)</li>
  <li>chore(deps-dev): bump start-server-and-test from 1.13.0 to 1.13.1 in /ui @dependabot (#3726)</li>
  <li>chore(deps-dev): bump lint-staged from 11.0.0 to 11.1.1 in /ui @dependabot (#3727)</li>
  <li>chore(deps): bump @rjsf/core from 2.5.1 to 3.0.0 in /ui @dependabot (#3734)</li>
  <li>chore(deps): bump caniuse-lite from 1.0.30001194 to 1.0.30001248 in /ui @dependabot (#3733)</li>
  <li>chore(deps): bump @material-ui/lab from 4.0.0-alpha.58 to 4.0.0-alpha.60 in /ui @dependabot (#3722)</li>
  <li>chore(deps): bump @cypress/code-coverage from 3.9.9 to 3.9.10 in /ui @dependabot (#3724)</li>
  <li>chore(deps-dev): bump cypress from 8.0.0 to 8.1.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#3732)</li>
  <li>chore(deps): bump github.com/gosimple/slug from 1.9.0 to 1.10.0 @dependabot (#3735)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Integration Test for <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">system logs</code> @piyushsingariya (#3708)</li>
  <li>[CI] use multiline if statements @iamsdas (#3703)</li>
  <li>[CI] Fix release drafter @DelusionalOptimist (#3450)</li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <h1>Meshery v0.5.43</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.43">Released</a> on August 07, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>fixed the chevron problem @warunicorn19 (#3794)</li>
  <li>[DashboardComponent] Changes settings button styling in notification bar  @CipherGirl (#3801)</li>
  <li>made changes to the performance calender @warunicorn19 (#3808)</li>
  <li>Fix Data Fetch and Logic from the server causing problems with pattern deployment @Abhishek-kumar09 (#3809)</li>
  <li>Remove cypress test spec for dashboard button  @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3803)</li>
  <li>[UI] [Connection wizard] Fix the meshery operator step connection status @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3806)</li>
  <li>Updated the Maintainers.md file @debjani1413 (#3802)</li>
  <li>Added custom context support in installer @devansh42 (#3498)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Unit Tests for <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">system token</code> @Revolyssup (#3737)</li>
  <li>[UI] Meshery Navigator Menu Re-iteration @Abhishek-kumar09 (#3779)</li>
  <li>[GraphQL] Query Performance fetch all results based on Performance Profile ID @bariqhibat (#3783)</li>
  <li>Changed docker compose default location @metonymic-smokey (#3788)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Delete older application command @piyushsingariya (#3786)</li>
  <li>[meshery] changes to installer script for missing utilities @hexxdump (#3789)</li>
  <li>Refactor connection wizard @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3790)</li>
  <li>Open API docs for application endpoint @sayantan1413 (#3643)</li>
  <li>Added a save icon in the save button @sayantan1413 (#3687)</li>
  <li>Added MeshSync Chip, Snackbar and Toolbar @Meghana-12 (#3698)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Tests for <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl pattern</code> commands @piyushsingariya (#3714)</li>
  <li>[CI] use access token in release notes publisher @DelusionalOptimist (#3777)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-documentation">📖 Documentation</h2>

<ul>
  <li>[Docs] Add notes to fix Ruby version problems in Meshery docs @alphaX86 (#3773)</li>
  <li>updated the contributing docs @warunicorn19 (#3757)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @CipherGirl, @DelusionalOptimist, @Meghana-12, @Revolyssup, @adithyaakrishna, @alphaX86, @bariqhibat, @debjani1413, @devansh42, @hexxdump, @leecalcote, @metonymic-smokey, @navendu-pottekkat, @piyushsingariya, @sayantan1413, @sudo-NithishKarthik, @warunicorn19 and l5io</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Meshery v0.5.44</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.44">Released</a> on August 09, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">What’s New</h2>
<h2 id="-general">🔤 General</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Revert “Changed docker compose default location” @navendu-pottekkat (#3824)</li>
  <li>[UI] Implement proxying for websocket requests in development server @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3822)</li>
  <li>[UI]] [Graphql] Use a single web socket connection for all graphql subscriptions @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3819)</li>
  <li>Added the unit test for mesheryctl system reset command @sayantan1413 (#3738)</li>
  <li>[GraphQL] Performance API - Integration frontend react relay @bariqhibat (#3785)</li>
  <li>Open Test Result Modal by Clicking Calendar Event @CipherGirl (#3815)</li>
  <li>[mesheryctl] Fix for <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl start</code> platform preflight checks @piyushsingariya (#3707)</li>
  <li>fix syntax error @suhaniii (#3810)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-maintenance">🧰 Maintenance</h2>

<ul>
  <li>Add lint pre-commit check with husky @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3704)</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="-contributors">👨🏽‍💻 Contributors</h2>

<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@CipherGirl, @bariqhibat, @dhruv0000, @leecalcote, @navendu-pottekkat, @piyushsingariya, @sayantan1413, @sudo-NithishKarthik and @suhaniii</p>

  src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>
